name_input: ADVIK HI TECH PRIVATE LIM ITED
note: Legal name confirmed as ADVIK HI-TECH PRIVATE LIMITED from the company's own website (advik.co.in, home and /contact pages), which also states 'Founded in 2000' and gives the registered office as Plot No. B-5, Chakan Industrial Area, Phase-II, Village Vasuli, Tal-Khed, Dist Pune 410501, Maharashtra; corporate office Baner, Pune. State registered = Maharashtra (Pune) per company website; input state_claimed was empty, so no mismatch to report. Role = manufacturer: own site describes 10 manufacturing facilities (Pune Kharabwadi/Wasuli, Pantnagar, Bawal, Bangalore/Kolar, Gujarat Chhatral) producing pumps, brakes, valves/actuators, alternate fuel systems - this is a self-declaration of manufacturing capability, not a registry record. CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date and MCA status could NOT be verified: search backend (searx) was down, and registry aggregators (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck, tofler, instafinancials) returned 403/404 or only generic landing pages; MCA portal not accessible with available tools. All such fields left null rather than guessed. Note the CIN U29299PN1999PTC014095 was NOT confirmed by any source and is therefore not reported. Revenue FY25/FY26: null - no audited accounts or MCA filings were retrievable; the website only shows an unlabelled 'Million USD Annual Turnover' counter with no figure in the fetched text, which is not an audited source. No rejection grounds found: the entity demonstrably exists and operates (active website, newsroom items dated Jan 2025 on Advik Europe GmbH acquisition and a demerger hearing notice), so no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy. Declared HS 841330 (pumps for engines) is broadly consistent with the company's stated oil/water/vacuum pump lines, but HS was not the object of this check and no correction is proposed. Outstanding verification needed: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status, FY25/FY26 revenue.
